styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Markets, Aapravasi Ghat and the Blue Penny Museum.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Street snacks, Creole curries and the central market.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Fort Adelaide, colonial streets and the immigration story.

stays.why: Walk to the market, Aapravasi Ghat and the Blue Penny Museum; safe to stroll in the evening.
Closest to the bus stations and the market; good for early starts and cheap eats.
Quiet streets near the racecourse and Fort Adelaide; short taxi to the centre.
Modern seafront quarter with restaurants and the light rail nearby.

food: Try Mauritian street food: dholl puri, gateaux piments and alouda, usually under MUR 100.
The central market in Port Louis is good for fresh fruit, spices and cheap local snacks; go in the morning.
Creole and Indo-Mauritian dishes to look for: rougaille, fish vindaye and octopus curry.
Seafood is best near the waterfront; ask the price per weight before ordering.
Chinese-Mauritian noodles and dumplings are common and cheap in the city centre; check opening hours on the day.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a trip to Pamplemousses Botanical Garden, north of the city; check bus and taxi options on the day.
History fans can add Aapravasi Ghat and the Blue Penny Museum in one morning, then Fort Adelaide for the view.
Beach lovers can take a day trip to the north coast; arrange transport in advance as ride apps are limited.

recommend.why: One night covers the market, Aapravasi Ghat and Fort Adelaide; add a night for museums and a slower food day.

month_notes: January: hot and wet, about 24 rain days. Pack a rain jacket and plan indoor sights.
February: still hot and rainy, around 21 rain days. Mornings are usually the driest.
March: hot with about 21 rain days. Expect short heavy showers.
April: warm with fewer showers, around 17 rain days. Good for walking the city.
May: cooler and drier, about 10 rain days. Comfortable for sightseeing.
June: mild and dry, around 7 rain days. One of the best months to visit.
July: coolest month, highs near 25°C, about 8 rain days. Bring a light layer for evenings.
August: mild and dry, about 8 rain days. Good for markets and forts.
September: mild and dry, around 7 rain days. Pleasant for outdoor time.
October: warming up, about 10 rain days. Still good for city walks.
November: hot and more humid, around 13 rain days. Start early to avoid the heat.
December: hot and wet, about 18 rain days. Expect afternoon downpours.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical city: hot and humid most of the year, with a wet summer and a drier, cooler winter.

items.title: Best time: June to September
items.text: Highs around 25–26°C and only 7–8 rain days. The most comfortable months for walking.

items.title: Wet season: January to March
items.text: About 21–24 rain days a month. Showers can be heavy; keep indoor plans ready.

items.title: Hot and humid summer
items.text: Highs near 30°C with lows around 25°C. Go out early and rest at midday.

items.title: Carry rain gear in summer
items.text: December to April brings frequent showers. A light rain jacket helps.

items.title: Cooler evenings in winter
items.text: June to September lows drop to about 20°C. A light layer is useful at night.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light breathable clothes, sunscreen and a hat; a rain jacket for summer; a light layer for winter evenings.

transit.best: Metro Express for suburbs and taxis for short city hops; buses are cheap but slow.

modes.text: Metro Express light rail links suburbs to the city, daily 6 AM to 10 PM, roughly every 12–15 minutes.
Two bus stations: Immigration Square for north and east routes, Victoria Square for south and west. Intercity tickets about MUR 15–30; express and AC buses cost more. City buses run until about 8 PM.
Taxis within the city cost about MUR 10–50, a bit more at night. Ride apps are limited; arrange taxis by phone or at ranks. Avoid rush hours.
Driving is chaotic, so park at the marina or hotel. Only worth it for trips outside the city.
Good for the waterfront and city centre in the drier, cooler months. Use taxis or the metro for longer hops.
